objective: C++20 native Nikon pixel-shift synthesis exclusively to NEFX

user_decisions.primary_platform: Native Linux, with verified native packaging for Linux x86_64/ARM64, macOS ARM64 and Windows x86_64
user_decisions.vendor_runtime: Wine and Nikon DLLs are research oracles only, not a product backend
user_decisions.public_artifacts: English only; repository text is ASCII
excluded_from_active_scope: General RAW rendering and other NX Studio features
A CLI clone of NX Studio
Linear DNG output and metadata inspection commands
user_decisions.implementation: C++20 reusable numerical and merge library with a thin CLI; Python is limited to native verification tooling, with no retained Python product implementation.
product_features: Pixel-shift synthesis for most Nikon cameras with official pixel-shift shooting; initial model set: Z8, Zf, Z6III and Z5II
NEFX output fidelity and downstream workflow compatibility
user_decisions.decision_context: The explicit 2026-10-30 cleanup request supersedes retention of the Python reference implementation. Historical source is recoverable from Git, including v0.0.1.

current_capabilities.merge: Experimental C++20 synthesis of complete 4/8/16/32-frame Nikon Z8, Zf, Z6III or Z5II sequences to NEFX; all nine input/output combinations
current_capabilities.output_set_publication: Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), macOS renamex_np(RENAME_EXCL), or Windows exclusive move after all outputs and the complete sequence pass validation
current_capabilities.chromatic_aberration_correction: Optional native source-metadata red/blue radial correction before crop; disabled by default
current_capabilities.sequence_validation: Explicit capture order, consecutive shot numbers, consistent observed metadata, distinct file identities, descriptor-bound decoding and final immutable source hashes
current_capabilities.nefx_writer: Native packed14 RGB, Nikon metadata updates and CRCs, private preview, preserved source JPEGs, atomic no-overwrite publication
current_capabilities.build: CMake/CTest; hash-pinned static LibRaw 0.22.3, no optional external codecs, LCMS, OpenMP or vendor SDK; native archives include provenance and dependency licenses
current_capabilities.api: Public C++20 numerical and merge contracts; synchronous cancellation and progress callbacks; JSON schema_version 1
current_capabilities.resource_ownership: One decode per capture index, bounded source-plane retention, sparse original-value snapshots and streaming TIFF image payloads; decoder buffers, output RGB and radial correction remain additional memory

historical_research: Obsolete Python synthesis, DNG, inspection, Picture Control and renderer implementations, tools and tests are removed. Synthesis format and validation records remain dated evidence for their recorded revisions.
acceptance_boundaries: Synthetic fixture and saved vendor-output agreement is not authentic capture validation.
LibRaw or Adobe SDK decoding is not Lightroom Classic acceptance.
A readable NEFX with the right samples is not byte-identical Nikon serialization.
release_gaps: Authentic complete pixel-shift sequences and matching NX Studio NEFX references for each enabled Nikon model
Downstream application acceptance of native NEFX outputs, including Lightroom
compatibility_limits: Source Adobe XMP defaults are preserved; vendor-equivalent default sharpening and noise reduction are not established. This is an appearance limitation, not evidence of different merged RAW samples.
HE/HE* decoding is unsupported. HLG, non-FX image areas, other firmware and broader correction parameters remain unvalidated.
Full-resolution resource measurements cover synthetic repeated-RAW cases, not authentic capture quality or a universal memory bound.
If LibRaw lacks a Z5II XYZ-to-camera matrix, synthesis reports that limitation and preserves source color metadata; it does not substitute calibration or render RAW data.
No-replace publication requires the relevant operating-system and filesystem primitives; published outputs survive parent-sync or cleanup warnings.
deferred_work: Exact vendor Adobe-default calibration is ancillary compatibility work and does not authorize Picture Control or general renderer development.
GUI, installed stable SDK/ABI, and WASM require separately agreed scope and acceptance.
active_priorities: Maintain strict C++20 four-model synthesis, all nine merge modes, pinned independent regression expectations and saved Nikon/firmware oracle comparisons.
Validate ordered synthesis against authentic capture and matching reference files when they become available.
Resolve concrete merge, NEFX serialization or resource defects demonstrated by capture validation.
Retain experimental status until authentic capture and downstream acceptance are established.

reference_project.role: External arithmetic oracle only; no product code or runtime dependency is imported.
